F1.evidence: Kitchen.co does not publish a colour ramp. main.css uses a handful of hex literals (ink #1d1c1d, coral #ed553b, sand #f8f6f4, gold #ffdc4d, grey #707070). The package records those roles, not a 10-step ramp per hue.

F2.evidence: Marketing page, sand and promo strip are measured. The workspace adds a pale rail and a dimmed overlay behind the Proposals dialog. No separate scrim token was named.

F3.evidence: Primary (#1d1c1d), secondary (#707070), on-ink and on-coral are measured. The wordmark link computes to the UA blue. No disabled text role appears on the public pages.

F4.evidence: The Log in button uses a 2px #1d1c1d outline. Hairline #e5e5e5 and field #dcdcdc are in the stylesheet. No separate focus-border token: focus-visible on the measured buttons did not change the border.

F5.evidence: Coral and ink buttons were measured at rest, hover, focus-visible and DevTools-forced pressed. The fills do not change. The states were captured; the product does not restyle them.

F6.evidence: The workspace declares --k-color-red #ee543b, --k-color-green #41c660 and --k-color-yellow #fec30c. Yellow paints on Upgrade. Green paints on the DocuMocu checklist. No info colour was measured.

F7.evidence: The site ships one theme. Every semantic role in the light set was measured on that theme. There is no dark theme to match.

F8.evidence: Marketing uses Graphik 16/18/22/72. The workspace uses the system UI stack at 13 and 14px (--k-font-size-*). No caption/code role was named.

F9.evidence: No spacing scale is declared. Measured padding is 14px 24px on the coral button and 10px 15px on the small header buttons. That is not a 4px or 8px scale.

F10.evidence: Buttons and fields use a 5px radius. The outline button uses a 2px border. There is no radius ladder.

F11.evidence: Small header buttons are 44px tall. Coral and plan buttons are 52px. The phone Menu control is 34px. No designed focus-ring width or offset was measured.

F12.evidence: Marketing cards are flat. The workspace --k-* layer declares shadows on dialogs and cards. The Proposals dialog was captured; its crop filled the viewport so the shadow was not isolated as a token.

F13.evidence: The motion probe on home, pricing and features recorded 150ms and 200ms durations. Reduced motion is ignored: the probe verdict is ignores, and no authored prefers-reduced-motion rules were found.

F14.evidence: Captured at 1440 and 390. The home shell content is 1280px wide. No named breakpoint or z-index scale is tokenised. The phone drawer is a captured layer, not a z-index token.

C1.evidence: Marketing plus workspace now show button, icon button, link, text field, tabs, menu, dialog, card, list row, table, avatar and badge. Text area, select, radio, switch, tooltip and toast still do not paint. Checkbox exists on create-workspace opt-in and was not measured.

C2.evidence: Marketing buttons have hover, focus-visible and pressed. Workspace primary was hovered. Tasks tabs show selected vs unselected. Disabled, loading and error were not held as screenshots.

C3.evidence: Focus-visible was applied to nav links, header buttons, the coral CTA, the plan CTA and the FAQ row. The workspace and signup fields were focused. The product often draws no extra ring.

C4.evidence: components.md quotes computed colours and sizes next to crops. Token names exist for the shared roles, but most component lines still show the raw computed value.

P1.evidence: patterns.md covers marketing chrome, pricing, signup, the workspace rail, empty lists, the Proposals dialog and free-plan billing. Destructive confirmation and action feedback were not shown because nothing was written.

A1.evidence: Graphik is named with its commercial status and a Helvetica Neue / Arial fallback. The wordmark is an icon font, not an SVG set, so icons/ is a declared layout gap. The marks are in the screenshots.

K1.evidence: The README states the date, the public route, the signed-in free workspace, the widths, how --k-* values were read, and what to distrust.
